title: Shopify Just Put Your Marketing on Autopilot
description:
Shopify just turned store marketing into full autopilot.

The new Spring 2026 update added Campaign Autopilot, an AI console inside your admin that runs and optimizes ads and email on its own across Facebook, Instagram, Shop and email. You set the budget and guardrails, it handles the rest. Plus an AI sales associate in Inbox that answers buyers from your real catalog.

Full breakdown in my community, link in bio.

#ecommerce #shopify #ai #marketing
